workarounds.symptom: Tailwind CSS v4 removes '@tailwind base; @tailwind components; @tailwind utilities;'. Agents generated v3 CSS syntax resulting in un-styled raw HTML.
workarounds.workaround: Replace CSS directives with '@import "tailwindcss";' and install '@tailwindcss/postcss' with postcss.config.mjs plugin '@tailwindcss/postcss': {}.
